create_inputmap: create an InputMap instance to bind keyboard and mouse events to callbacks
bind_key_callback: bind a key combination to a callback function using InputMap bind method
bind_exclusive_action: bind an Exclusive action that triggers a callback on key press and release
bind_plane_callback: bind a callback to handle planar mouse movement via bind_plane method
bind_z_axis_callback: bind a callback to handle mouse wheel scroll via bind_z_axis method
